MiniWireshark **5.0.2**: layout and loading bug campaign.

Found with a crawler that opens every tab, sub-view, dialog and settings
page in English/French/Spanish, light/dark, four text sizes and screen
sizes from 1024x768 to 1920x1080, records every exception and measures
cut-off text, overlapping widgets, overlapping chart labels and cut
headings, plus screenshots reviewed by eye (FR 1366x768: 664 -> 0).

Layout
- Main tabs drawn by a wrapping TabStrip (ttk cut them: "Tableau de bor")
- FlowLayout: toolbars and dialog button rows wrap instead of squeezing
  buttons to nothing; label+field pairs stay together; pack()/forget()
  keep working through hooks
- Labels with a wraplength re-wrap to the width they get (damped)
- Button bars under a list keep their height (protect_bottom)
- Dialogs grow to their content and never exceed the screen; main window
  no longer opens partly off-screen after the Welcome Center
- Compact density under 820 px height, merged not-live banner, auto-hiding
  info banner with a close button, fold-away quick filters, lighter
  sub-view buttons, presets in a small menu, error line only when needed
- Dashboard scrolls, cards reflow 6/4/3 per row, charts use their real size
- Charts measure titles, legends and axis labels (no overlaps); map legend
  below the canvas, ring and remote list fit, names de-cluttered
- Health rows stack on narrow windows; side panel scrolls; settings page
  list sized to its names and scrolls; checkbox labels wrap
- Table headings never narrower than their text; table text follows the
  text size; time column fits its format
- Tooltips hide when their widget disappears and stay on screen

Loading / behaviour
- Packet list and status loops survive an exception (they stopped for good)
- UI flush parts guarded separately; a failing part rebuilds its tab
- Dashboard click opened the wrong device when some had no traffic
- Ctrl+Tab works from anywhere in the main window
- Empty feed / packet list after opening a session say why
- Live status line and mode banner translated; "1 device" not "1 devices"
- Welcome Center said "MiniWireshark 4"; its footer was cut on 768 px

Tests: layout_audit() in the app; GUI steps for the layout at 1000x690
(FR/ES, large text) and for error recovery; 115 self-tests, 36 GUI steps,
live test pass.



---
**Run it:** download the `.py` file and run `python <file>` (Python 3.8+ with Tk). Check the download against the attached `.sha256` file.
Archived release, kept for reference. The current version is on the [latest release](https://github.com/darkckillerc4/MiniWireshark/releases/latest).
